note: Gang heat (PLAN.md W5; user 2026-10-03): one heat per (player, gang), INDEPENDENT of the police stars and NOT cleared by a hospitalisation or an arrest. Stars from heat by `stars_at`. At `attack_at` stars that gang's members (the crowd's included) attack the player on sight; at `chase_at` they hunt the player (the dispatch, not built yet). Below `pay_at` stars the heat drains after `calm_seconds` at `decay_per_second`; at or above `pay_at` it only goes away by paying the gang's `fee_per_star` x stars dollars as a 'donation' at one of that gang's gray-area counters. Police do not care about gang heat. Adding a gang = one entry in `gangs`; a gang crime = one row in `crimes` + one GangSystem.report call.

hangout.note: Gang members loitering in front of every place the places record marks with a gang (game.GangHangouts, PLAN.md 0.1): `count` per place, spawned within `near` m of a player, returned past `far` m of every player; set down `ring` m out from the door toward the street; they patrol `patrol_radius` m round their spot. NEUTRAL to the player until provoked (DefaultFactions.tres): the first hit is hit_member heat = attack_at.

hunters.tokens_note: PLAN.md 1g b2/b3 (2026-10-07): tokens_by_stars = how many units may attack one player at once (the rest close in and hold, the token rotates every 4 s; 0 = no limit). regroup_seconds_by_stars = after half the units on a player have run dry (they walk back to a vehicle's spare ammo, item/ammo_supply.json, within supply_reach, else leave), no new unit is sent for this long: the escape window. 0 = no lull.
hunters.note: A gang hunting a player at chase_at stars or more (game.EnforcementDispatch). Index = the player's stars with that gang. Same spawn rules as the police dispatch; gang members always shoot. From ram_at stars their cars drive AT the player; units always follow the player into a building through its door (PLAN.md W6).
hunters.light_note: PLAN.md 2.3 follow-up (2026-10-16): light_by_stars = LIGHT combatants (ai.light: no nodes, never deal damage, promoted to full bodies as they close in under the World density light_full_budget) sent round the player beyond the full complement; every foot unit the global body cap refuses is sent light too. Drawn from the same station pools. The numbers are UNREVIEWED picks.

abduction.note: 拉致 ABDUCTED (game.RespawnSystem / GangSystem, user 2026-10-06): a player who goes down with ANY standing against a gang wakes at one of that gang's places (the places record's `gang`), held by `guards` armed members. Two ways out: pay the ransom (ransom_per_star x that gang's stars; it also clears the standing), or ESCAPE -- step past escape_start metres from where they were held and the guards open fire (+ the `escape` crime's heat); past escape_free metres the player is free.
